original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_CEMSlot1 and TEMP_CEMSlot2 as the two approved CEM slot-zone temperature channels, proving exact physical slot and sensor identity plus consistent names, descriptions, readings and states across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The platform owner defines CEM and maps Slot1/Slot2 to physical connectors, installed card population and probe/source location, supplies condition-specific thermal criteria, then automation performs passive complete cross-path collection.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner defines CEM, maps both slots and installed cards, identifies each sensing source, approves limits and Web entries. No card service, link/load or airflow change is authorized.
required_inputs: Authoritative CEM meaning and CEMSlot1/CEMSlot2 physical connector/location map
Installed card vendor/PN/serial/revision/BDF or explicit empty-slot state
Sensor source as card telemetry, slot-area probe or board-controller estimate and exact coordinate
Expected SDR name/entity/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable/empty semantics
Approved ranges/states under documented card population, link/load, cooling and ambient conditions
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/card/board/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent link/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve Slot1 and Slot2 separately and do not infer the CEM acronym
Bind each reading to physical connector, installed card serial and sensor source
Prove same-target IB/OOB and retain complete inventories before filters
Keep slot-zone sensors distinct from TEMP_CEMBB
Do not service cards, flap links, create workload, alter airflow/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, link/card fault, cross-path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, CEM/slot/card topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact Slot1/Slot2 records
Prepare Web parity and passive card/link/load/fan/SEL context
Perform no slot/card/link/load/threshold action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define CEM and approve slot/card/sensor-source mapping
Confirm Web mapping and empty-slot handling
Review both slot channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: literal range, OOB-only exact query, capped SDR, password exposure and absent Sensor List/Web evidence do not meet the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List, query each mapped slot record and compare Web evidence with card population and passive link/load context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CEMSlot1~2, four command views, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; CEM meaning, card population and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES CEM SLOT/CARD SENSOR MAP, THERMAL CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-row connector/card-serial/sensor-source matrix and reconcile complete IB/OOB plus Web evidence under documented passive conditions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical slot/card and sensing-source provenance while preserving the undefined owner-controlled CEM term.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A literal range, CEM baseboard value or one slot's evidence cannot prove both slot zones.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Empty slots, replacement cards and board-proxy sensors change thermal meaning even when the firmware label remains stable.

project_override_considerations: Empty slots need explicit expected-state rules. If both slot labels share one board probe, the owner must document the alias and coverage; one value cannot be counted as two independent sensors by assumption.
expected_evidence: Owner-defined CEM and two-slot connector/card PN/serial population map
Per-slot probe/source coordinate, SDR/entity/description and Web mapping
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Two-record cross-path value/state parity with units/freshness/limits
BMC Web entries and passive link/load/fan/ambient/SEL context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets two CEM slot temperature channels across IB/OOB and Web. Undefined CEM topology and numeric limits are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive two-slot thermal check is identifiable; CEM definition, slot/card mapping and criteria are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds owner-defined CEM meaning, physical slot/card and sensor-source provenance, restores complete cross-path evidence and isolates CEMBB coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A slot temperature may originate from an installed card, a connector-area probe or a shared board sensor; those locations respond differently to workload and an empty slot. Physical connector and card serial binding is essential, while keeping CEMBB separate prevents a baseboard average from masking a local slot hotspot.
